summary: Master budgeting and financial reporting with our comprehensive training course designed for property managers. Enhance your skills and boost your career today!
lede: Budgeting and Financial Reporting for Property Managers helps you build operating budgets, validate rental income assumptions, control expenses, and explain movements in net operating income. You will connect financial data with leases, occupancy, work orders, supplier contracts, and cash activity to produce reports owners and leadership can use. Practise creating rent roll and cash flow forecasts, reconciling actuals with approved plans, reviewing arrears and accruals, and building variance bridges and management dashboards in Excel and Power BI. The course also covers service charge reconciliations, reserves, capital expenditure, prepaid expenses, and structured monthly review controls.
audienceIntro: Property management budgeting training suits professionals who prepare, review, approve, or rely on property-level financial information. It is calibrated for intermediate to advanced learners who already work with budgets, invoices, leases, operating expenses, or management reports.
modules: Property Budget Integration and Action Planning
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to property operations, budgeting, accounting records, lease administration, facilities costs, or management reporting. You do not need programming experience, and coding is not required for completion. Working knowledge of spreadsheets, operating expenses, rent rolls, and monthly financial reports will help you apply the exercises effectively. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted variance analysis and Power BI dashboard configuration are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering level.
